races.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An excellent opportunity for LEVENS HALL to defy a penalty. Aura Champagne looks more solid than El Nay and she shades the vote for next best. Newcomer Francesca's Dream is also worth considering for the places if backed. LEVENS HALL AURA CHAMPAGNE (IRE) EL NAY (IRE)

races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict: ARTHUR CARROT had a bit more in hand than the final margin indicates when accounting for stablemate Bacha at Lingfield the previous week, so a 6 lb higher mark looks well within his compass, especially as it's doubtful we've seen the best of him yet. Odegaard has shaped well on both his nursery outings and is one to take seriously, while last-time-out winner Thai Baht should have the race run to suit again on her first try at 7f. ARTHUR CARROT ODEGAARD THAI BAHT

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There was definite promise to glean from UNFURLED 's debut second at Wolverhampton 32 days ago and, appealing as a likely improver with that run under her belt, she could be the answer with her yard firmly amongst the winners of late. Mantuba and Secha are 2 very appealing newcomers from leading stables and may offer up chief resistance before market clues. UNFURLED (IRE) MANTUBA (IRE) SECHA

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict: PALMS OASIS continued his theme of race-by-race progress when opening his account at the third attempt in a C&D novice 3 weeks ago, defeating a next-time-out winner in the process. An opening mark of 74 looks fair on that evidence and he's selected to follow up. Blue Pete is another going the right way and feared, with similar comments applying to Henley on Thames . Lady Blanche also worthy of note in a good race of its type. PALMS OASIS BLUE PETE (IRE) HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)

races.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict: Dual C&D winner ELYAM maintained his 100% record for Michael Herrington and found further progress to boot when bringing up the hat-trick in determined style at Newcastle 4 weeks ago. A low-mileage 4-y-o, he firmly appeals as the type to rate higher still and is selected to defy the handicapper again. Ancient State has been a fine advert for the Adam Kirby yard this year and is feared, whilst a pace duel could well bring admirable veteran Baldomero into contention late in the piece. ELYAM ANCIENT STATE (IRE) BALDOMERO (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Elyam (11/10), Rhythm N Hooves (5/2), Ancient State (5/1), Baldomero (12/1), Dazzling Haze (14/1), Jack The Bachelor (16/1)

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2027 Not 2007 Handicap
races.verdict: LEADING TIMES is easily one of the least exposed and found further progress when making a winning stable debut over C&D 3 weeks ago, finding plenty for pressure to edge out Toolatetonegotiate late on. Further progress rates a distinct possibility and he looks a big player again nudged up 2 lb. Sir Yoshi wasn't disgraced last time and faces his easiest assignment for some time, so commands respect despite a poor strike rate. Aforementioned Toolatetonegotiate completes the shortlist. LEADING TIMES SIR YOSHI (IRE) TOOLATETONEGOTIATE
